prologue.text: Santa! Me again. Great meeting. One of the best meetings I've ever had.
Just out of curiosity... where do you keep the List?

l1.text: Santa! Heard you beat Frost. Fantastic. Tremendous fight, I'm told. Tremendous.
Word travels. I have the best people. Keep it up, big things are coming. Huge.

l2.text: Santa! Krampus. Horns. I knew he'd be there.
I know things. Everybody says I know things. Great job, by the way. Very strong. Very goat-free.
